what: International Paper makes containerboard and corrugated boxes. After buying DS Smith and separating its global cellulose fibres business, it is focused on packaging in North America and Europe.
customers: Food and beverage producers, e-commerce shippers, consumer goods companies and industrial manufacturers.
money: large after the DS Smith acquisition
moat: Mills integrated with box plants on two continents, serving multinational customers in every market they operate in, at a scale few competitors match.
risks: It reported a large loss after mill closure and impairment charges
Containerboard prices are cyclical and box demand has been weak
Integrating DS Smith while closing North American capacity is a large undertaking
opportunities: Revenue grew about 49% last year as DS Smith was consolidated
Analysts see about 35% upside, with mill closures intended to tighten supply
watch: Box volumes, containerboard pricing, and cost savings delivered.
